upstream.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

classification.analysis: gstack is Garry Tan's Claude Code setup packaged as roughly 23 slash-command skills plus power tools that role-play CEO, eng manager, designer, reviewer, QA, security officer and release engineer. Skills are Markdown templates with a Bun/TypeScript runtime, a bundled headless browser, and installers for Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kiro and Copilot hosts. It targets founders, tech leads and first-time Claude Code users who want a structured plan, review, QA and ship workflow, backed by extensive CI and eval workflows.
